title: Health report
description: Body of GET /health and GET /healthz: the object buildHealthReport in src/health.ts returns, serialised with JSON.stringify. HTTP 200 when ok is true, 503 otherwise. Every object is closed (additionalProperties: false), so a field added to or renamed in the report must be changed here too; tests/health-schema.test.mjs fails until it is.

status.description: "ok" while running, including an operator pause or a graceful drain; "degraded" when polls are stale, failing, or a cursor is stale or stalled; "stopped" when the poller is not running.

network.description: The STELLAR_NETWORK name, or one inferred from the passphrase: testnet, public, futurenet, mock or custom.

paused.description: Intentional operator pause: the process is ready but no new cycle starts.

stopping.description: A graceful shutdown is draining: no new cycles, unsent messages are dropped.

lastCorrelationId.description: Correlation id of the most recently started poll cycle.

chainClockAt.description: Newest chain close time observed; null until one is seen.

chainClockSkewMs.description: checkedAt minus chainClockAt: positive while the local clock is ahead of the chain, negative when behind, null while chainClockAt is null.

eventsDeduplicated.description: Events suppressed as already seen across overlapping pages and resumes.

cursorRewinds.description: Cursors rewound to the RPC's retained floor this run.

deadLetter.description: Sends that exhausted their retries and wait to be replayed. Counts only: no message text, no destination.

suppressedLogs.description: Repeated error lines summarised instead of printed since start.

restartGaps.description: Restart gaps detected since this process started.

lastRestartGap.description: The most recent resume position that fell below the RPC's retained window. Ledger numbers only.

pendingFlush.description: In-memory cursor state that is not on disk yet.

version.description: Contract version used to pick the decoder, e.g. v1 or v2.

lastCycleMs.description: Duration of this target's most recent attempted cycle, in ms; 0 before the first one.

maxCycleMs.description: Longest attempted cycle for this target since process start, in ms.

cursorPreview.description: Opaque resume cursor, not a secret. Longer cursors are cut to 24 characters plus an ellipsis.

gapLedgers.description: Ledgers lost to the retained window at this target's last restart gap.

cursorResetAt.description: When this target's stale cursor was last rewound.

cursorUnreadable.description: A cursor is persisted but no ledger can be read out of it.

rewindFromLedger.description: Ledger the target resumes from after a floor rewind.

cursorStale.description: The RPC rejected this target's cursor as stale; true until a scan succeeds.

cursorStalled.description: The cursor stayed unchanged for CURSOR_STALL_CYCLES cycles while behind the tip.

cyclesWithoutAdvance.description: Successful cycles with an unchanged cursor while behind the tip.

config.description: Where configuration came from: setting names and sources, never a value.

profile.description: Active MIMIR_PROFILE, or null when unset.

suppliedKeys.description: Known settings whose effective value the .env file supplied.

entries.description: Every setting the bot reads, in a stable order.

key.description: Variable name, e.g. BOT_TOKEN. A name is not a value.

derivedFrom.description: Present only when source is derived: the setting this one inherited from.

emptyDeclaration.description: Present (true) only when the variable is set but empty, so a fallback won.

counts.description: How many settings each source supplied.

warnings.description: Actionable, value-free notes for boot logs and health checks.
